name: t5
title: Call of Duty: Black Ops (T5)
note: BO1 (T5), 32-bit: the Steam BlackOps.exe (SP and zombies, 2011-09-01 build) is not encrypted (.text entropy 6.73), flattened (file offset == RVA). Load_Stream, push and pop are real functions (509, 115 and 44 calls): no inlined stream.
rva_note: read off BlackOps.exe: DB_LoadXFileData (dst, size on the stack) is called only by Load_Stream 0x1a3780 (flag, dst, size: idx-1 <u 3 -> 1 memset, 2/3 recorded for later; else read then DB_IncStreamPos 0xe5e70); DB_ReadXFileString 0x205530 (dst) copies a C string out of the inflate buffer itself, calling the file read only when the buffer runs out, and returns its length with the NUL: hooked as file_string; Load_XStringCustom 0x55490 (char**); DB_PushStreamPos 0x3ca60 (block) and DB_PopStreamPos 0x60ed0 (a pop into block 0 rewinds it); DB_AllocStreamPos 0x16e2d0 (alignment - 1); DB_InitStreams 0xf34d0 (the XBlock table, 8 bytes per block); DB_InsertPointer 0x117150 pushes 4, aligns 4, takes 4 bytes, pops; DB_ConvertOffsetToPointer 0x1daca0 and DB_ConvertOffsetToAlias 0x19bf20: block = (v - 1) >> 29

asset_dispatch.note: Load_XAssetHeader: compares varXAsset->type and tail-jumps to the type's Load_<T>Ptr with its var set to varXAssetHeader (Load_XAsset 0x103c40 reads the entry, sets varXAssetHeader = varXAsset + 4, jumps here)

stream.growing_blocks_note: the recording: blocks 4 (virtual, 4 631 886 reads) and 6 (physical: vertex and index buffers, 44 305) only grow over all 159 zones; block 0 (temp) is rewound by every pop into it (324 094 of 324 341 reads below its previous end); 5 holds nothing
